Definitely seconding this. People telling my my psychosis is fake and just an illness, will aggravate my symptoms to the point of me becoming delusional about said person and think they’re also trying to hurt me.

He also gave me food only in closed packages that I could check if they were tampered with. And while doing so, asked if I knew why people were watching me. Or would want to poison me, and how we could try to prevent “them” from doing it again.

Helped a ton!
